# Outreach budget review, 2026-01-29

Annual review of the outreach budget with the network director.

- The large print budget rises by 3,000 dollars, mostly for [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]] readers, who go through large print quickly.
- Six new audiobook players were approved.
- Mileage reimbursement for volunteers stays at the county rate.
- Funding for the jail deposit collection continues at the 2025 level.
